scope: Read-only method review and six outcome-selected stress examples. Not population uncertainty or a calibrated coadd PSF. Existing validated results were not edited.

findings.pair_formula: For sky-projected templates and independent equal-variance pixels, std-error inflation = norm(host)/norm(host projected off neighbour span); nearest pair=1/sqrt(1-rho^2).
findings.gaussian_FWHM_interpretation: Reported FWHM for inflation2 constrains a nearest pair only; it is not sufficient to deblend all candidates.
findings.all_candidates_limitation: Unregularized signed amplitudes for every optical candidate deliberately assume all unknown infrared contributions are free. No physical flux or calibrated confidence interval is measured.
findings.rank: All six empirical nuisance matrices remain full rank; worst singular ratio6.89e-6 is well above1e-10 truncation. Large conditional inflation is not by itself floating-point failure.
required_sensitivities: Exact coadd/spectral-shape and correlated-noise assumptions remain outside model

stress_example_design: For each band select the existing all-candidate median and maximum VIF host after inspecting output. Rebuild catalogue neighbour geometry and actual valid map-pixel grid, reuse acquired empirical beam profile and projection utility. Smooth only radial profile with scipy Gaussian sigma0.5 or1 arcsec. Pixel sensitivity averages nine radial-template samples at offsets{-1/3,0,1/3} times native pixel width in each axis. This is a model sensitivity, not an assertion that the actual mapmaking kernel is a top hat.
status: review findings conveyed; root independent numerical validator and scientific note pending
